text:
ken: Heads-up — planning a cautious slow-roll for flag `pinwalk_beta` during tonight's 00:30-02:00 UTC change window. goal: limit exposure while validating model v9.0.1 routing. plan: 0% -> 0.5% -> 3% -> 12% -> 40% with 12m gates. soft-pin v9.0.1 for each step, fallback to v8.9.4.

tara: adding rollback criteria: immediate drain to 0% if p95 +250ms or 5xx +1% sustained 4m. also abort on auto-quality-eval fail (we'll run the quick set after each step).
deploybot: scheduled job queued: 20241201-llmroute-pinwalk at 2024-12-01T00:30:00Z. will emit step events.
sre_bot: monitoring config: latency_p95, 5xx_rate, token_quality_regressions. page on sev1 if p95 > 650ms OR 5xx_rate > 2% for 3m. runbook link: https://wiki/internal/rollouts/pinwalk.
ken: ops checklist (short):
```
- t+0: set pinwalk_beta = 0.5%
- wait 12m, run smoke prompts, validate p95/5xx/quality
- enable soft-pin model=v9.0.1 for 8m after each bump to avoid oscillation
- t+12: 3% if green; t+24: 12%; t+36: 40%
- fast-disable: `releases flag set pinwalk_beta 0 --immediate`
```
zara: I'll own the quality evals and will post pass/fail + short diffs. will also attach the quick prompts to the release notes.
deploybot: step1 executed: pinwalk_beta = 0.5% (7481234287). next bump scheduled in 12m.
tara: smoke pass #1: p95 +8ms, 5xx flat, no regression on quick eval set. green to proceed.
sre_bot: telemetry snapshot: p95=145ms (+8), 5xx=0.09%, token_quality stable. within gates.
ken: bumping to 3% now. calling out before action.
deploybot: step2 executed: pinwalk_beta = 3% (7481234707). holding for 12m.
zara: quality after step2: tiny drift in a narrow prompt category (0.4% BLEU drop) — investigating whether it's model or routing. recommend holding before next bump for 12m.
tara: hold agreed. pausing scheduled bump. if drift increases or any infra signal crosses threshold, we fast-disable and pin back to v8.9.4.
sre_bot: observability note: kv_cache_miss +0.35% correlated with drift window. tagging infra team to check cache eviction logs.
ken: updating release notes: "paused at 3% for targeted triage of a minor quality drift; soft-pin retained; no customer-facing errors observed." :memo:

zara: deep-eval shows the drift isolated to one tokenizer edge-case; patch scheduled for model infra team. if fix can't ship quickly, plan is to roll to 0% and pin to v8.9.4.
ken: thanks team — will resume or rollback depending on triage. ops oncall: @tara, @ken. closing thread while we wait for infra patch; will re-open when we have a resume decision. :white_check_mark:
